h1: Custom Ringer Shirts for Teams & Events
metaDescription: Shop custom ringer shirts for teams and events. Perfect for retro style. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Ringer shirts add a vintage sporty edge to your company uniforms or event giveaways, with contrasting collar and sleeve bands that stand out from standard tees. Whether you are outfitting a race team or creating retro staff shirts, these custom ringer shirts offer a classic look that prints well with screen printing or embroidery. Choose from cotton or performance blends for comfort all day.
heroAltText: Group of people wearing custom ringer shirts with contrasting trim at a corporate event
